name: Eval run controls — time window, agent switcher, URL state and the not-found notice
description: Walks the agent eval page (L06) on the seeded eval history (server/src/db/seed-eval.ts: two manual cases and four completed suite runs, 60 / 20 / 3 and 1 days old, for General Reviewer and Security Reviewer): opens General Reviewer from the /eval landing cards, picks the 7-day window (it lands in the URL), reloads and finds the window and its 2 runs restored from the URL (AC-13), switches to Security Reviewer (a pushed history entry that keeps window=7d) and goes Back to General Reviewer with the window intact (AC-13), then opens an agent id that does not exist and lands on /eval with the 'agent not found' notice (EC-11). Never clicks Run eval, Run all agents, Compare or Promote — each starts a paid review call or needs a second version. The two <select>s are addressed by their option values (the window's carry 7d, the agent switcher's do not) because a bare `select` matches both. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml.

steps.label: open the eval dashboard landing
tall viewport so every later click target is inside it (agent-browser does not scroll before a click on Linux; see flow 13)
landing data settles
the seeded agents' cards have rendered
open the General Reviewer card (exact: the name must not match another card)
navigate to the agent eval page
the window selector renders
agent eval data settles
pick the 7-day window
the window is in the URL
the windowed runs settle
the 7-day table shows the two newest runs (3 and 1 days old)
reload on the windowed URL (AC-13)
the page renders again after the reload
the window selector shows 7 days, restored from the URL
the table still shows 2 runs after the reload
switch the agent to Security Reviewer
the switcher shows Security Reviewer once the new route has rendered
the window survives the switch
Back to the previous agent (the switch pushed a history entry)
General Reviewer is selected again
the window is still in the URL after Back
open an agent id that does not exist
the page redirects to the landing with the notice (EC-11)

cmd: That agent was not found or has no eval cases.
steps.label: the notice text is visible
